import json, pathlib, yaml
work = yaml.load(pathlib.Path('.github/workflows/deploy_oss.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
jobs = work['jobs']
verify, deploy = jobs['smooth-verify'], jobs['deploy-oss']
assert deploy['needs'] == 'smooth-verify'
assert verify['steps'][0]['with']['fetch-depth'] == '0'
assert verify['steps'][0]['with']['ref'] == deploy['steps'][0]['with']['ref']
print(json.dumps({'checkout': verify['steps'][0]['with'], 'deployNeeds': deploy['needs'], 'runner': verify['runs-on'], 'verificationSteps': [step['name'] for step in verify['steps'] if 'run' in step]}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
